integrity: The exact finite arithmetic checks supplement the mathematical argument. Existence and nonexistence for infinitely many graph orders depend on explicit constructive and analytic proofs, not experimental extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted adjacency crown graphs with n>=3; arbitrary Borel probability observation-time laws; no claims for weighted graphs, noise, minimal sampling support, or broader graph lifts. The classification has not undergone independent validation.
title: Randomized-time uniform quantum mixing on crown graphs: exactly two connected cases
